source.name: University of South Carolina Major Map Repository

notes: Each map retains its official PDF URL, source hash when available, extracted semester sequence, and parser warnings.
Ambiguous requirements remain informational and are not converted into invented course requirements.
The 2020-2021 collection is based on surviving official PDF inventory because that year is no longer fully indexed by the current repository page.
Rows without an official PDF are recorded as source gaps and are not fabricated.
